 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Nilesh Dave - Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. Rajendra Singh Suryavanshi appearing on behalf of Advocate General[r-1].

Heard on IA No.17784/2025 , second application seeking suspension of sentence on behalf of appellant appellant Santosh who has been convicted under sections 450, 354(D), 376(2)(N) and 506(Part-2) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 05 years, 01 year, 10 years and 02 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, Rs.500/-, Rs.3,000/- and Rs.500/- respectively with further default stipulations vide judgment dated 13.08.2025 in S.T No.43/2023 by the Additional Special Judge,
POCSO Act, Mandleshwar.
2. First application for suspension of sentence was dismissed as withdrawn by this court vide order dated 06.10.2025.
3. Counsel for the appellant submits that the trial court has committed error in convicting and sentencing the appellant.
It is further submitted that the parents of the victim have not supported the case of prosecution.
The final hearing of the appeal will likely to take long time, hence prayed for suspension of sentence and release of the appellant on bail.
4. Counsel for the State opposed the prayer.

5. Considering the facts and circumstance of the case and the arguments advanced by counsel for the appellant and the fact that the parents 2 CRA-8361-2025 of the victim have not supported the case of prosecution, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed and it is directed that the execution of remaining jail sentence passed against the appellant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 09.03.2026 and on such further dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry during the pendency of this appeal.
6.
Consequently, I.A.No.17783/2025 which is an application for urgent hearing is also disposed of.
7. List the case for final hearing in due course.
